assertions: The response routes the request to both the drugcomb and drugcombdb sub-skills.

The response uses the DrugComb schema (drug_row/drug_col, cell_line_name, synergy_zip, synergy_bliss) for the DrugComb source and the DrugCombDB schema (Drug1/Drug2/Cell, Synergy, SynergyType, PMID) for the DrugCombDB source.
The response names distinct per-source API functions (e.g. drugcomb search/summarize vs drugcombdb search_drug_pair/search).
The response explicitly contrasts the two schemas and does not merge them into a single column set.
The response compares the consistency of the combination and cell line across the two sources.
